translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
aik doosray say barh charh ker ( duniya ka aesh ) hasil kernay ki hawas ney tumhen ghaflat mein daal rakha hai ,
yahan tak kay tum qabarstanon mein phonch jatay ho ,
hergiz aisa nahi chahiye . tumhen unqareeb sabb pata chal jaye ga ,
phir ( sunn lo kay : ) hergiz aisa nahi chahiye . tumhen unqareeb sabb pata chal jaye ga .
hergiz nahi ! agar tum yaqeeni ilm kay sath yeh baat jantay hotay ( to aisa naa kertay )
yaqeen jano tum dozakh ko zaroor dekho gay ,
phir yaqeen jano kay tum ussay bilkul yaqeen kay sath dekh lo gay .
phir tum say uss din naimaton kay baaray mein poocha jaye ga ( kay unn ka kiya haq ada kiya ) .
